name: Social Recon
description: We found a suspicious user handle '@GhostAdmin99'. Can you find the flag hidden on their public profiles?

name: The GitHub Leak
description: The target deleted their secret repository, but the internet never forgets. Dig into the GitHub commit history to recover the leaked data.

name: Corporate Espionage
description: A former employee posted sensitive infrastructure details on a forum that has since been taken down. Use web archives to find the original post.

name: Missing Admin
description: We suspect the company is hiding a shadow domain for internal admin use. Enumerate their subdomains to find the missing admin portal.

name: Inspect Element
description: A junior developer said they 'hid' the password on the login page. Inspect the source code closely to find what they left behind.

name: Blind SQLi Login
description: The login portal is vulnerable, but it doesn't return database errors. Use True/False Boolean conditions to extract the admin password.

name: SSRF to Internal
description: You found a cracked admin password. Now, exploit the server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability to bypass the firewall and access internal systems.

name: Prototype Pollution
description: The application merges user settings insecurely. Overwrite the base Object prototype in JavaScript to grant yourself admin privileges.

name: Caesar's Salad
description: This encrypted message looks like a salad of letters. Shift the characters back to their original positions to read it.

name: Vigenère Key
description: The cipher uses a repeating key, making standard substitution impossible. Crack this polyalphabetic cipher to reveal the flag.

name: Weak RSA
description: We intercepted an RSA public key and ciphertext. The prime numbers used for the modulus are way too small. Factor them and decrypt the message.

name: Broken Curves
description: This elliptic curve digital signature (ECDSA) implementation reused a nonce. Use this mathematical flaw to calculate the private key.

name: Magic Bytes Fix
description: We recovered a PNG image, but it won't open. The file header magic bytes have been corrupted. Use a hex editor to fix them.

name: PCAP File Carving
description: Analyze the provided network capture. Follow the TCP streams to carve out the hidden file being transferred.

name: Deep Steganography
description: Analyze the provided 'stego_challenge.png' file. We suspect secret audio data has been embedded inside the least significant bits of the pixels.

name: Volatility LSASS Dump
description: We acquired a Volatility memory dump from a compromised Windows machine. Extract the LSASS process memory to find the plaintext credentials.

name: ARP Trace
description: Someone is spoofing MAC addresses on the local network. Analyze the PCAP to find the malicious ARP poisoning packets.

name: BGP Route Hijack
description: Traffic is being maliciously redirected to a rogue autonomous system. Trace the BGP route hijack to find the spoofed AS path.

name: Fortinet Evasion
description: The attacker bypassed the Fortinet firewall using fragmented ICMP packets. Reassemble the payload to find what they smuggled in.

name: Custom C2 Protocol
description: We detected strange DNS traffic. The attacker is using a custom C2 protocol over DNS. Analyze the TXT queries to extract the flag.

name: RockYou Basics
description: We found a standard password hash. It's likely a very common password. Use the RockYou wordlist to crack it.

name: Hashcat Rule Mangling
description: The user got smarter and added symbols and numbers to their password. Use Hashcat rule mangling to mutate your wordlist and crack the hash.

name: Local Dictionary
description: This target uses a password based on their local city. Build a custom dictionary using Pretoria-based keywords and variations to crack it.

name: NTLMv2 Relay Hash
description: We captured an NTLMv2 hash from a relayed authentication attempt. Crack this captured admin hash to retrieve the flag.

name: Basic Strings
description: Examine the 'secure_vault.bin' file. The developer hardcoded the password. Run a strings analysis to extract the visible plaintext flag.

name: GDB Binary Patching
description: The 'patch_me' binary requires a token we don't have. Use GDB to modify the assembly jump instructions and force the program to grant access.

name: Stripped ELF Packing
description: This executable has been packed using UPX and stripped of symbols. Manually unpack the binary to find the original entry point (OEP) and the flag.

name: Custom VM Bytecode
description: The malware uses a custom virtual machine to hide its logic. Reverse engineer the opcode dispatcher to understand how the bytecode executes.

name: Manifest Leak
description: Analyze the provided Android APK. Check the AndroidManifest.xml for an insecurely exported activity that leaks data.

name: Hardcoded APK Secrets
description: The developers left API secrets hardcoded in the Android app. Decompile the APK using Jadx and search the strings.xml file.

name: Insecure Broadcast
description: The app broadcasts sensitive intents without permissions. Intercept the insecure system broadcast to capture the flag.
